name: Motor restart-inhibit block
summary: Suppresses an automatic restart under the documented post-trip or supply-return condition.
description: Suppresses an automatic restart under the documented post-trip or supply-return condition. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Trip and supply-return status” at the input and “Restart inhibit” at the output. Restart permission must follow the operating philosophy.
